description: gzapp.decks' rules for fabric-pr arm. boundary.paths: the repository builds decks and documents with Node scripts and a Marp engine that runs on the operator's machine and calls a provider with a key, so its boundary is the scripts that build, bump, release and generate images (scripts/), the package manifest and lockfile that decide what installs and runs (package.json, package-lock.json), the Marp configuration, which loads the theme and enables raw HTML and local files in the export browser (.marprc.yml), the shared theme the engine loads (theme/), the harness wiring (.claude/: settings, hooks and the commands that run the build, the release and the image generation), the environment template and the ignore file that keeps .env.local out of a commit (.env*, .gitignore), CI (.github/), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/, scripts/ or theme/: Markdown prose (a command file under .claude/ is not prose, it is what the harness runs), .agent-fabric/, and the deck and document folders' content, their assets/ and i18n/ dictionaries. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.

direct.description: Direct to main: brand-comms commits deck and document content, their assets and i18n dictionaries, and the theme's styles and fonts straight to main (the owner, 2026-10-10). By pull request: what runs on the operator's machine or decides what installs and loads (scripts/, bin/, tools/ and every script outside a deck's assets/ and i18n/, .marprc*, the manifest and lockfiles, *.config.*, Makefile/Dockerfile), the harness wiring (.claude/, .mcp.json), CI, hooks, .env* and .gitignore, any file whose git mode is executable, and secret-shaped names (secret, credential, api key, auth token, private key, password, .pem/.p12/.pfx/.key). Styles, design tokens, fonts, images and content are direct.
